notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Dear beloved Onii-chans,

Thank you for your supports!

For the past week, your cute sisters have been working tirelessly toward improvements to become more enjoyable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575888/b0b2211db6c7f80b67362383b5e700cc50e0b157.png


Here are what changes:

- Additional Content:
+ Two new sisters: Irina and Kaoru
+ Irina is available for only 100 love and there will be a lot of items in store for her.
+ Add [Cat Paws] item to shop, which can be equipped by most characters

- Game improvement:
+ Add setting to change between monitor 1 and 2.
+ Add setting to change dialogue box size. Also, dialogue box size now scale with character.
+ Add setting to enable/disable dialogue box.
+ Each sister now have dialogue box with their own color.
+ Now you can interact with overlapping characters without the need to drag one out.
+ Spawned sisters and their position will be saved and loaded for the next sessions.

- Bug fixes:
+ Fix a bug where you can drag your sister and Setting button outside of the screen.
+ Fix a bug where Character Hub window isn't updated when Rest button is clicked.
+ Dialogue Box will now follow sister more closely (when sister's size is changed).

Once again, thank you for your support! And please look forward to our next update in the future!

Love you forever!

Your Sisters.
